data.narrative:
Neros is a Series C-stage defense and security company founded by Soren Monroe-Anderson and Olaf Hichwa, currently valued at $2.5B post-money on $250M total raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 15 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Castelion, Stark Defence, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI. The peer range spans $300M to $13.0B, with a median of $2.2B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series C to next-stage multiplier of 1.7x to the current $2.5B valuation, implying $4.2B. Peer-median analysis anchors to the $2.2B median valuation across the 15-company comparison set, reflecting observed market pricing for similar-stage defense tech businesses. These methods yield a triangulated range of $1.9B (low) to $4.9B (high), with a median implied value of $3.2B.

The current $2.5B valuation sits at the lower bound of the triangulated range, suggesting modest headroom relative to peer-derived benchmarks. Key uncertainties include stage-specific risk factors, capital efficiency relative to the peer set, and the wide dispersion within the defense sector ($300M to $13.0B), which reflects material differences in technology maturity, customer concentration, and contract visibility among comparable businesses.
